# Grown from an iPhone 18 Pro Max play session on 2026-11-27 (the owner's Documents/pso_user.tsv after two runs of build 96ed6c798, chain a380ea4b5737, 1.2.1, Balanced, Picture Stretch, built through NX Play from the provisional profile; first boot to the opening movie, where the game aborted): 6302 rows (6217 S, 73 R, 0 C), 0 M, 12 K, in the order of first use; every row checked with pso_seed.py add against upstream's shader map (f35ebba74, 30,630 keys), none refused; the profile registers no shader map (tables_from split), so each build checks the list against its own split's map. The K rows are one-draw passes the phone drew with no pass-as-compute kernel: they ask the next shader build for those kernels (dmsh_chain.pc_pairs), as in Ocarina of Time's 2026-11-25 phone import
